sources.snippet: Detoxify Onnx is a high-dimensional text embedding and semantic retrieval model developed by Gravitee Io. Tailored for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector database indexing, semantic similarity matching, and cross-lingual passage re-ranking.
